dialogues.speaker: Caravan Ribat Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: As an entrance to Sumeru, Caravan Ribat is a critical pass. This Bulletin Board is established to inform merchants and tourists of important matters. Please heed the notices on the board often.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My love, though you are so far away from me, my heart belongs to you as always."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I know. You have more important things to attend to. After all, the higher position you are in, the more responsibilities you shoulder."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But I couldn't share with anyone the thing that is troubling me so deeply. I couldn't tell them your name."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hope one day I'll be able to let everyone know how learned and wise you are."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: To the Great Red Sand.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Those who do not revere the deceased shall stay here.

dialogues.speaker: The Eremites Announcement
dialogues.text: The Akademiya strictly forbids destruction in any form of the Wall of Samiel.

dialogues.speaker: The Eremites Announcement
dialogues.text: Any violation will be severely punished.

dialogues.speaker: Traveling Merchant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Preserved fruit, dessert ingredients and other desert specialties on sale."

dialogues.speaker: Traveling Merchant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Delivery is available for large-quantity orders."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This looks good. I could make Dango with it. Can you deliver it to Inazuma?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "My apologies. Cross-border delivery is only available to Liyue."

dialogues.speaker: Gilded Journey Advertisement
dialogues.text: Although it seems there's no need for Gilded Journey to advertise as it's the only hotel in Caravan Ribat.

dialogues.speaker: Gilded Journey Advertisement
dialogues.text: Our barbecue is savory with the authentic tinge from the desert. Way more authentic than in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Gilded Journey Advertisement
dialogues.text: Exhausted travelers, be sure to come for a taste.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hope the Mahamata considers tightening customs restrictions at Caravan Ribat."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Now any desert folk can pass through the border, giving bandits the chance to flee into the jungle for a hide and taking jobs away from people in Sumeru."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Akasha has not been available to the desert folk, but commissions issued by Citadel of Regzar cover way more than mercenaries. If it goes on like this, even all sit in for the entrance exam for the Akademiya, some will lose their jobs anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about? The desert folk are the people of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, and they are people of Sumeru as well. It is only natural that they are allowed to enter the city."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Be careful when you say this here."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Researchers who stay in Caravan Ribat for a long time must register with the Mahamata before checking in at the hotel to avoid knowledge leakage and other unexpected happenings.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Merchants and travelers must register with the Mahamata for approval to cross the border.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: It is forbidden to carry unregistered goods or contraband goods prohibited from import and export. Any cargo in violation will be confiscated and related parties will be expelled into the desert in accordance with the regulations.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: In addition, residents of Aaru Village can cross the border with the clearance issued by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Traveling Merchant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Desert adventure package for sale. Offering the most caring desert adventure solutions for merchants and travelers."

dialogues.speaker: Traveling Merchant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "For those who purchase the package, we guarantee that you will safely return from your trip. We are liable for a ten-time fine for any counterfeit sold. Pre-order now to enjoy a discount!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I heard the Akademiya had set up a hospital in the desert for Eleazar. But it was abandoned for some reasons unknown..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "According to residents of Aaru Village, there were cured Eleazar patients who'd escaped from there."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If there's information left there, it might lead to a cure for the disease..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "They say one of us from Aaru Village has become a high official at the Akademiya. We desert folk might well live a better life in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I barely earn enough carrying these stones. But with a single order of carrying something like cans of knowledge, I could afford to get married back at my hometown."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "But I heard that that official happens to be one who tackles smuggling. I don't think that person will be on our side."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Tsk, that's how we desert folk end up like this. We don't unite."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Adventurers going to the desert, please note that all adventures to the Great Red Sand must be registered at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Relics found in the desert belong to Akademiya in principle, and no one shall take possession of them.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Due to security concerns, a ban on access to desert areas excluding the Sea of the Great Red Sand has been issued by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Akademiya assumes no responsibility for any accidents in the areas.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "They say some people earned a fortune just by selling sand pupa grease in the city. Now they have mansions there and claim themselves to be some kind of family. Even pretending to be cronies with those at the Akademiya."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I've spent most of my life carrying stones here, and I still have nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "What do you know? Sand pupa grease is a business licensed by the Akademiya. You can't even have a finger in the pie."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "If you wanna make a fortune, come smuggle books with me. If it works out, at least we won't need to carry stones here anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Young people overthink everything these days. Hadn't it been for Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, we Aaru villagers would have long been skeletons under the ruins of those temples."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I overheard someone say that King Deshret might come back to life. Even that Greater Lord Rukkhadevata never came back after all these years, let alone King Deshret."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Better get to our work now. We can't afford to live with the few supplies delivered to Aaru Village every month."

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Permanent recruitment of workers for Wall of Samiel maintenance.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: We offer a fair salary with free meals and accommodation.

dialogues.speaker: Mahamata Announcement
dialogues.text: Outstanding employees will be recommended by the official to receive further education at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Poem
dialogues.text: "I have forgiven your sins in the name of the King of the Magic Bottle, yet who shall forgive ours?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hope the Mahamata considers tightening customs restrictions at Caravan Ribat."

dialogues.text: "Now any desert folk can pass through the border, giving bandits the chance to flee into the jungle for a hide and taking jobs away from people in Sumeru."

dialogues.text: "What are you talking about? The desert folk are the people of the Dendro Archon, and they are people of Sumeru as well. It is only natural that they are allowed to enter the city."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Be careful what you say here."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Young people overthink everything these days. Hadn't it been for the Dendro Archon, we Aaru villagers would have long been skeletons under the ruins of those temples."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I overheard someone say that King Deshret might come back to life. How absurd!"

dialogues.text: "Better get to our work now. We can't afford to live with the few supplies delivered to Aaru Village every month."
